description: A day with Amina: Fort Jesus, coconuts and the ocean.

choices.label: Nzuri sana. (Very good.)
choices.reply: Amina smiles. "Nzuri sana! Then Mombasa will show you its beauty."

choices.label: Salama. (Peaceful.)
choices.reply: Amina nods. "Salama! A calm heart sees far."

scene1.culture: On the Swahili coast, "Karibu" (welcome) is a way of life; guests are treated like family.
scene1.translation: "How are you, guest!" A warm Swahili welcome.

choices.label: Twende! (Let's go!)
choices.reply: You climb the old ramparts together, the ocean sparkling below.

choices.label: Subiri kidogo! (Wait a little!)
choices.reply: You pause for a fresh madafu (coconut) before the climb.

scene2.culture: Fort Jesus, built in 1593, has watched over Mombasa's harbour for centuries.
scene2.translation: "Let's go to Fort Jesus!" Amina points to the old coral-stone fort.

scene3.culture: Swahili farewells are warm: "Safari njema" wishes someone a safe journey.
scene3.translation: "Goodbye, friend!" The dhow sails into the sunset.

title: Amina's Mombasa Day
